initial_state.scene_layout: red book rests on the countertop between a blue mug on the left/back side and a potted green plant on the right/back side

intended_change.agent: a hand entering from the right side of the frame
intended_change.action: gently lift the front cover of the red book
intended_change.result: the book is opened enough to reveal the first page

completion_criteria: A hand appears from the right side and contacts the red book's front cover.
The front cover rotates upward/open from its initially closed position.
The book transitions from closed to open.
The first page beneath the front cover becomes visible.
The book remains on the countertop in approximately its original position.
protected_anchors: blue mug at the back-left area of the counter
potted green plant at the back-right area of the counter
book identity as the same red hardcover book
countertop lighting and photorealistic kitchen setting
negative_constraints: Do not move the book to a different location.
Do not change the book's color, size, or material appearance.
Do not remove or rearrange the mug, plant, backsplash, or countertop.
Do not reveal pages without opening the front cover.
Do not open the back cover instead of the front cover.
Do not have the book slide, fall, tear, deform, or disappear.
Do not introduce unrelated objects or people beyond the reaching hand.
failure_modes: The hand does not enter from the right side.
The hand interacts with the wrong object.
The cover moves but the first page is not revealed.
The entire book moves substantially instead of only the cover opening.
The scene layout changes, such as the mug or plant shifting position.
The red book changes into a different object or a different-looking book.
The action opens the book unrealistically, damages it, or causes it to vanish.
